objective.statement: Normalize devbox language package cache variables into one user-scoped cache tree without moving executable Cargo tools.
objective.measure: Managed session variables and activation migration pass the focused cache-layout contract.

need.statement: The devbox currently splits Cargo, Mix, Hex, and npm state across unrelated home paths.
need.baseline: Only CCACHE_DIR is explicitly managed; Cargo, Mix, Hex, and npm use separate default paths.
need.consequence_of_no_action: Cache ownership remains unclear and package caches are harder to inspect and clean consistently.

assumptions.statement: ~/.cargo/bin must remain stable for installed Cargo tools.
assumptions.falsifier: A rendered profile no longer exposes ~/.cargo/bin or cargo subcommand proxies fail.

alternatives_considered: Move all Cargo state under ~/.cache and rewrite PATH

purpose: Give devbox package caches explicit, inspectable user-scoped homes aligned with runner semantics.
consumer: Home Manager sessions and language package managers on cc-se-sto-devbox-01.
contract: XDG, Cargo, Mix, Hex, and npm cache variables are explicit; Cargo's executable home remains ~/.cargo; legacy Mix/Hex/npm directories are migrated only when the destination is empty.
failure_boundary: The focused cache-layout test fails if any variable or migration hook is missing; activation never merges or deletes two populated cache trees.

evidence.description: Focused RED/GREEN cache-layout test and repo check nix.

falsifier.claim: The devbox cache layout is normalized without breaking tool homes.

executable_check.description: The focused contract rejects missing variables or migration logic.

non_goals: Running home-manager switch in this change
invariants: Home Manager remains the devbox authority
Existing populated new cache directories are never overwritten

assumptions.statement: The operator will activate this through the declared cc-se-sto-devbox-01 Home Manager target.
assumptions.falsifier: The target is absent from flake.nix or activation does not render the variables.
